notes: Resistor value: the manual's parts list says 82 ohm while the schematic label says 220 ohm; 82 used per the parts list.
The breadboard image shows rows f-j in the upper half; in the catalogue naming that half is bank 'b' (rows f-j), so holes are written like '3b.h'.

Hole positions read from the image: green wire at column 3 row g, resistor from column 3 to column 6 on row h, LED anode (bent longer leg) at column 6 row i, LED cathode at column 8 row i, black wire end at column 8 row h.
Wire1 runs from MKR pin 2 (D2) to the resistor; wire2 runs from MKR GND to the LED cathode strip.
The micro USB cable is for power and programming; it is not drawn in the circuit image, and it has no ports in the catalogue, so its edge has no port names.
The built-in LED alternative is not built. The external LED circuit is built, as the task requires.
